The role in a nutshell:

Our customers include some of the most regulated organizations in the world, and we have a strong and growing UK and European customer base. Europe is one of our highest-growth priorities.

description:
SpaceXAI’s mission is to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge.  Our team is small, highly motivated, and focused on engineering excellence. This organization is for individuals who appreciate challenging themselves and thrive on curiosity. We operate with a flat organizational structure. Work ethic and strong prioritization skills are important. All employees are expected to have strong communication skills. They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

Develop, maintain, and communicate construction schedules that the field, subcontractors, and leadership can actually use. You will build CPM baselines, update them from real progress, flag risk early, and explain schedule impact of changes, delays, and recovery plans. This is not a data-entry role. You need enough means-and-methods knowledge to challenge a sequence that will not work in the field.

Superintendents run the work; project managers own cost and contracts; the scheduler is the person who can tell you what is actually driving the end date, what slips if a trade is late, and whether a recovery plan is real.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Build baseline CPM schedules from drawings, specs, estimates, bid packages, and construction sequences (WBS, activity coding, logic, calendars, and constraints used sparingly and correctly).

• Maintain the live schedule: collect progress from superintendents, project managers, and trades; update percent complete, remaining duration, and logic; publish a clean current-period update on a set cadence (typically weekly look-aheads and monthly official updates).

• Own the critical path. Identify near-critical work, float erosion, and out-of-sequence progress. Tell the team why the end date moved, not just that it did.

• Produce three-week (or similar) look-aheads that match the master schedule and what the field can actually crew.

• Analyze schedule impact of RFIs, change orders, design late-outs, access constraints, long-lead procurement, weather, and labor shortages. Prepare time-impact analyses (TIA) and what-if, recovery, and acceleration scenarios.

• Coordinate with project managers, superintendents, estimators, procurement, design, owners/CMs, and subcontractors so the schedule reflects committed dates, not wishful ones.

• Resource-load and, where required, cost-load the schedule. Flag crew stacking, craft shortages, and unrealistic production rates.

• Prepare narratives, variance reports, S-curves, histograms, and executive summaries for internal reviews and owner/CM submittals.

• Support claims and delay documentation with contemporaneous records (as-planned vs. as-built, fragnets, delay categorization) when needed.

• Enforce schedule standards: naming, coding, update process, backup, and version control so the file remains auditable.

• Facilitate or support pull-planning / Last Planner sessions and convert those commitments into logic in the CPM model.

• Visit the site regularly. A scheduler who never walks the job will be wrong.

title: Senior Systems Software Engineer - NV Cloud Functions
description:
Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIA N, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world. NVIDIA Cloud Functions (NVCF) is an open-source platform that links workloads to GPUs. It lets teams deploy, manage, and serve GPU-accelerated, containerized applications across regions and clusters worldwide. The platform routes inference, streaming, and batch jobs across decentralized GPU clusters. This allows endpoints to scale repeatably, whether hosted on-prem or in the cloud.
We are seeking a Senior Systems Software Engineer to join our team. You will focus on improving the performance, reliability, and scaling behavior of a system that routes AI workloads onto distributed GPU fleets. You will work on a polyglot platform that is now fully open source, with both control plane and edge deployments. The work suits someone with deep experience in systems performance, distributed systems, and Kubernetes-based runtimes. We are looking for engineers who want to learn and grow. Expect to be challenged in an environment with rapidly shifting priorities, where insight, focus, and execution are key.
What you will be doing:

• You'll be working in a distributed team that explores innovative ways to make GPU- and DPU-accelerated applications easier to develop, deploy, and monitor on the latest and greatest NVIDIA hardware.

• Design and ship services in Java, Go, and Rust, building in the open on a public repository where your commits, design proposals, and reviews are transparent to the community.

• Work on automating and optimizing build, test, integration, and release processes for cloud native.

• Partner with engineering teams across NVIDIA so the platform integrates with adjacent NVIDIA technologies, including the KAI Scheduler, NVIDIA NIM, Grove, and Dynamo.

• Help steward an open-source project. You will triage community issues and pull requests and write docs contributors can build on.

What we need to see:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience

• 3+ years of hands-on software engineering.

• Expert-level knowledge in a systems programming language (Go, C, Rust) and a proven understanding of Data Structures, Algorithms, and Distributed Software Architecture

• Strong understanding of container orchestration systems (Kubernetes) and container technologies with hands-on automation experience in continuous integration frameworks like GitLab & ArgoCD.

• Expertise in a scripting language (Bash, Python) and knowledge and experience working with the system internals of Unix/Unix-like kernels such as Linux.

• Understanding of performance, security, and reliability in complex distributed systems.

AI NEEDS A NEW INFRASTRUCTURE LAYER. WE'RE BUILDING IT AT MODAL.

Every era of computing brought new workloads that previous infrastructure couldn't support: mainframes, databases, and the cloud. Each time, the company that rebuilt the layer underneath defined the decade. AI is no different, except it touches everything instead of one slice, and the window to build the layer underneath it is open right now.

Our customers include category-defining companies like Ramp https://modal.com/blog/how-ramp-built-a-full-context-background-coding-agent-on-modal, Cognition, DoorDash, and Suno. They rely on Modal for instant GPU access, sub-second container starts, and native storage, so it's simple to serve low-latency inference, fine-tune models, and access production-ready sandboxes at scale.

We've passed $1B in annualized run rate, up 15x from a year ago. In October 2026 we raised a $750M Series D led by Accel at a $15.75B valuation.

Our team includes creators of popular open-source projects (e.g.,Seaborn https://github.com/mwaskom/seaborn,Luigi https://github.com/spotify/luigi), academic researchers, international olympiad medalists, and experienced engineering and product leaders with decades of experience.

THE ROLE:

We are looking for strong engineers with experience and interest in designing, building, and maintaining the novel, high-performance systems that make up our serverless platform. Specifically, you'll be working on the distributed object storage system that underpins every container image, volume, and checkpoint on Modal: hundreds of petabytes of data, replicated across multiple cloud object stores and a CDN, cached on local NVMe across a large fleet of workers in many datacenters, and shared peer-to-peer within each datacenter. You'll make cold starts feel local when the data is hundreds of milliseconds away, designing the caching, preloading, and peer-to-peer layers that hide object-store latency and keep public ingress off saturated uplinks. You'll own durability and cost at petabyte scale, from streaming and batch replication between origins, to garbage collection over billions of objects. You'll work across the stack, from local disk and page cache to distributed blob storage and garbage collection and you'll help shape what storage becomes next as we push storage closer to workloads.

REQUIREMENTS:

- 5+ years of experience writing high-quality production code

- Experience building high-performance distributed storage or caching systems at a large scale (the more challenges you've worked through, the better)

- Strong cloud skills, including deep familiarity with object storage (S3 or similar), CDNs, and their consistency, throughput, and cost characteristics

- Strong knowledge of low-level operating system foundations (Linux kernel, file systems, page cache, containers, etc.)

- Willingness to step into the thick of it with our on-call rotation and respond to production incidents

NICE-TO-HAVES:

- Experience with replication, content addressing, and consistency models in multi-region or multi-cloud systems

- Experience operating storage systems at scale (petabyte-scale datasets, high-throughput read/write paths, large-scale garbage collection or data migration)

- Experience with data engineering at petabyte-scale.

- Prior experience with Rust

KEY THINGS THE TEAM IS WORKING ON:

- P2P sharing of data across workers within a single datacenter to dramatically reduce ingress

- Replicating data across multiple blob storage providers

- Automating garbage collection across hundreds of petabytes of data

- Deploying colocated storage clusters to datacenters to accelerate high-throughput customer workloads

3698 - Manager, Solutions Planning, Global Client Solutions 

Role Summary and Impact

This role is the perfect opportunity for an ambitious graduate, somebody early on in their media career or looking for a change to build an excellent foundation in media and account management operations. You will gain an understanding in the inner workings of a global media account building a solid grounding in the administration and business acumen that supports world-class activation of paid media for our client.

This role sits within the Operations team in the global account management team. Working closely with the wider global planning and strategy team, the function’s role is to ensure smooth end to end process from planning to reporting, financial management and campaign performance metrics are collated from the local markets and shared with the global clients.

The right candidate will have independent input into projects and the capacity to be involved in proactive asks and forward thinking to improve and build efficiencies on existing process.

You will work as part of the Booking.com team reporting into the Global Business Director.

Responsibilities

• Work with local markets to ensure their ongoing and ad-hoc deliverables are supplied to global for onward use with clients

• Responsible (with support) for the update and distribution of the budget and changes tracker each month

• Creation of the fortnightly industry newsletter and thought leadership, sharing with clients

• Planning and strategy team support for data-driven tasks such as share of voice and spend calculations

• Working with our reporting client on building out data stacks and solutions to help build efficiencies in this area

• Keep abreast of EMEA media channel developments, understanding the landscape and keeping abreast any industry news.

Performance Measures

• Successfully completes onboarding and training programme

• Is meeting the job requirements and delivering the preset responsibilities

• Positive attitude to tasks set by manager

• Builds a good rapport with the team

• Communicates effectively with the team and clients (where relevant)

• Shows initiative and eagerness to learn

• Attention to detail/accuracy of reporting

• Demonstrates good time management and multi-tasking ability

Skills and Experience

• Positive, enthusiastic with a can-do attitude

• Open and clear communication style, not afraid to ask questions about the tasks set

• A team player who is interested in and excited to learn more about the world of global media and the travel industry

• Comfortable with the use of Excel spreadsheets (advance user is a plus but not a prerequisite)

• Calm approach to managing deadlines

• Enthusiasm and interest to go beyond the task - to find the insight in the data, or to identify a time-saver in a current process

• A desire to learn and to be involved in numerous workstreams

• Proactive nature with strong self-motivation to succeed

Essential Criteria

• 1-2 years experience in media planning or other industry

• Inquisitive and eager to learn and develop as an excellent account administrator and manager

• Show an active interest and maintain knowledge of advertising industry at large

• Demonstrates a high degree of accuracy and numeracy in reviewing data sets

title: Senior Partner solution program manager (Financial Reporting, Data Management)
description:

As a Senior Partner Solution Program Manager, you will serve as a senior individual contributor responsible for driving partner implementation readiness across Workiva ’s Financial Reporting solutions and Data Management and AI capabilities. Operating as a seasoned solution specialist, you will collaborate globally across internal teams including Client Services, Professional Services, Product Enablement, Partner Strategic Initiatives, and Product Management to ensure our implementation partners are equipped, certified, and empowered to deliver successful projects for our customers.
You will work on multi-faceted enablement programs and apply project management methodologies to define certification tracks, build 1:many enablement programs, curate implementation assets, and represent the partner voice during product releases.
What You’ll Do

Program Leadership & Partner Implementation Readiness

• Lead complex, global enablement projects across Client Services, Professional Services, Product Enablement, Partner Strategic Initiatives, and Product to ensure implementation readiness assets and certification training are aligned with Workiva technology releases

• Design, organize, and execute scalable 1:many enablement programs, including virtual and in-person instructor-led workshops, hands-on training, and product update webinars

• Drive the end-to-end creation and ongoing maintenance of high-quality enablement content, including partner certification coursework, practical exam scenarios, implementation guides, and technical solution blueprints for Financial Reporting, Data Management, and AI

• Plan and promote structured knowledge-sharing channels to accelerate feature adoption and deepen partner understanding of Financial Reporting solutions, and AI and Data Management capabilities

Governance, Certification & Partner Advocacy

• Define and maintain role-based delivery certification paths, manage badging workflows (e.g., via Credly and Skilljar), and establish tracking/reporting processes for partner implementation records

• Act as a key stakeholder for partner interests, remaining current on Workiva product enhancements and advocating for partner technical needs during product launches and design reviews

• Oversee event logistics and administrative operations for virtual and in-person partner training sessions

• Independently lead and execute special projects to refine processes as the global partner enablement organization scales

What You’ll Need
Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in a related field

• 6 years of professional experience in partner enablement, technical program management, or SaaS consulting/professional services

• 3+ years of experience with the Workiva platform, specifically in Financial Reporting and Data Management

Preferred Qualifications

• Understanding of partner dynamics and consulting delivery models

• Working knowledge or experience with enablement tech stack tools such as Credly, Salesforce, Zendesk, and Skilljar is preferred.

• Project management skills with a track record of driving cross-functional deliverables to completion on schedule

• Ability to take broad program objectives, break them down into structured project plans, and execute with minimal supervision.

• Strong interpersonal and communication skills to influence internal cross-functional partners

• Ability to evaluate feedback, spot trends, and implement practical solutions to improve program quality and operational efficiency

Travel Requirements & Working Conditions

title: Senior Mainframe RACF Security Administrator
description:

We have a Permanent or 12 month renewable contract as a Senior Mainframe RACF Security Administrator with our large consulting client, working on a long term project for one of Canada's largest banks. This could be an indefinite contract or a permanent role.
Role: Senior Mainframe RACF Security Administrator
Type: Permanent or Long Term Contract
Duration: 12 months to start + possible multiple extensions or a permanent role
Salary or Rate: approximately $180,000 - $230,000 + bonus as permanent employee or $100 - $130/hr + C2C - depending on overall experience
Location: Remote, Toronto, ON, Canada
As a Sr. Mainframe Consultant, RACF Security Administrator, you are responsible for providing technical direction and subject matter expertise to ensure stable, reliable environments for complex sharing initiatives in compliance with established controls, standards, policies, and procedures. You will collaborate with and advise senior management, utilizing your solid understanding of business dynamics to analyze and protect test environment integrity and mitigate risks, present alternative solutions, and recommend solutions using available resources for complex initiatives with key dependencies. You will provide technical leadership, interpret complex information, and coordinate client, provider, and vendor relationships to meet and manage service expectations, aligned to best practices. In addition, you will help to develop the team to maximize individual contributions and professional growth, while functioning effectively with your colleagues.
How you'll succeed

•
Technical Expertise you will leverage your solid technology expertise to review and analyze current client software and requirements to determine the most effective solution to include in business proposals; install, upgrade and customize ISV software tools in a multi-system z/OS mainframe environment, and help to ensure software and hardware remains current to avoid End of Support costs.

•

You will provide and document problem analysis, resolution, and prevention, designing procedures and best practice techniques, using IBM and ISV online tools for opening and managing problem report tracking and resolution. You will actively participate in periodic disaster recovery exercises, maintaining disaster recovery readiness of systems, and monitoring status of systems to proactively prevent issues from occurring.

•
Relationship Management You will collaborate with internal business partners in Application Development, Infrastructure, IT Operations, and IT Production Support to accomplish organizational goals that are consistent in supporting both IT and Business objectives. You will work directly with Hardware and Software vendors on solutions, build your network, and deepen existing relationships. You will leverage your verbal, written, and presentation communication skills to build strong partnerships, while influencing participants to mutually beneficial outcomes.

Who you are

•
You can demonstrate a minimum of 10-years' experience in Mainframe technology operating systems or system programming experience and you are a security administrator and the focal point for planning security in the installation. In addition, you also have:

• An understanding of System z architecture and deep expertise on mainframe configuration and performance of RACF and related IBM, and Vanguard Security tools.

• Experience with z/OS security and z/OS systems programming functions.

• Understanding of RACF security protocols.

title: Bookkeeper/Accountant for Dog Rescue (volunteer, 5 hrs/week)
description:
Bookkeeper/Accountant
Job Industry: Charity / Social Services / Non- Profit Organization
Position Name: Bookkeeper for Dog Rescue - Volunteer (Unpaid)
Job Location: Spokane, Washington, United States
Job Type: Part Time
Office Setting: Fully Remote
Remote: Yes
Compensation: Volunteer
Hours Per Week: 5 (flexible)
Role Mission
Bookkeepers play a critical role in maintaining the financial integrity and smooth operation of the Rescue. Bookkeepers maintain accurate financial records, enabling informed decisions and maximizing resources for the dogs in our care.
The Bookkeeper is responsible for categorizing all financial transactions: donations, expenses, and program revenue. The role involves reconciling bank statements and assisting with budget preparation.
The Bookkeeper works closely with a team of other Bookkeepers to share the load and ensure no one volunteer is overworked.
What Winning Looks Like
Key Results Area #1 - Timeliness and Accuracy of Financial Transactions

• KPI : Ensure all financial transactions are accurately recorded and categorized on a weekly basis.

• Metric : 100% of weekly transactions entered and accurately categorised by the end of each week, with no more than 2% errors in categorization during monthly reviews.

Key Results Area #2 - Effective Communication

• KPI : Maintain timely and clear communication with the CEO and other Finance Department team members to ensure up-to-date and accurate financial records.

• Metric : Respond to CEO and Accountant queries within 2 business days; submit monthly financial reports on time with no critical errors.

Key Results Area #3 - Financial Record Transparency

• KPI : Maintain transparent financial records that enable informed decision-making and effective resource management.

• Metric : 100% compliance with internal audits; provide accurate financial reports that require no more than two revisions per quarter.

Needed Skills

• Experience in Bookkeeping or Accounting

• Proficiency in Quickbooks Online

• Self Motivated - hours are flexible, but we dont have time to be reminding you to finish tasks. We need a self motivated person who can follow through with assigned tasks

• Willing to work in a team - we know that this role is typically a lone wolf role, but we have found that having a small team of volunteers in this role helps relieve the pressure from each person individually

• Meticulous, detailed, organizedyou know the drill

Unique Company Culture and Mission
Our Mission
At Path of Hope Rescue we save pregnant dogs and puppies from high kill shelters in the Southern United States.
Our Spokane, Washington based Rescue strives to decrease the euthanasia rate of high risk dogs in the southern United States by transporting pregnant dogs and puppies to the Pacific Northwest to find adoptive homes. We do not have a kennel or building location and are 100% foster based. We currently have two paid employees and rely heavily on volunteers and fosters as we work to build out our paid staff roles.
Our Vision.
Eliminating euthanasia of dogs in the South by decreasing the amount of dogs breeding unchecked and becoming the number one dog destination in Spokane by capitalizing on Spokanes love of Rescue Dogs.
Core Values:
Transparency - sharing the good with the bad
Community - dog loving people who treat each other well
Integrity - doing what you say will do
Golden Rule - treating others how you would want to be treated
Our Company Culture
We are freedom loving American Patriots who love dogs, freedom and Jesus.

No NGO status here, we dont take a single penny from the government. We are 100% funded by small donors and our adoption program, with a few small private grants here and there. We built this organization from the ground up in 2018 with $87.

We are built tough and believe that hard work pays off. Were about rolling up our sleeves and taking responsibility for our own actions. We dont do drama. There are no victims here and the system isnt out to get you,
